segments.tr: مع اقتراب انتهاء التمويل الفيدرالي بموجب تقويم مخصصات السنة المالية 2026 في 30 سبتمبر، لجأ الكونغرس مرة أخرى إلى أداته الميزانية الأكثر ألفة: القرار المستمر.

segments.src: A bipartisan measure to keep federal agencies funded into December cleared the Senate by a lopsided 90-6 margin before moving to the House, averting an October 1 shutdown that both parties said they wanted to avoid heading into a politically sensitive stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: وقد أقر مجلس الشيوخ إجراءً ثنائي الحزب للحفاظ على تمويل الوكالات الفيدرالية حتى ديسمبر بأغلبية ساحقة بلغت 90-6 قبل إحالته إلى مجلس النواب، مما حال دون وقوع إغلاق في الأول من أكتوبر، وهو أمر قال كلا الحزبين إنهما يرغبان في تجنبه قبل فترة حساسة سياسياً من التقويم.

segments.src: The vote tally itself tells a story.
segments.tr: نتيجة التصويت بحد ذاتها تروي قصة.

segments.src: A 90-6 outcome in a chamber known for narrow, party-line splits signals that neither side wanted its fingerprints on a shutdown this time around.
segments.tr: تشير نتيجة 90-6 في مجلس معروف بالانقسامات الحزبية الضيقة إلى أن أياً من الطرفين لم يرغب في أن تكون بصماته على إغلاق حكومي هذه المرة.

segments.src: But the lopsided count also masks how little the underlying disagreements have actually been resolved — a continuing resolution, by design, doesn't settle a budget fight so much as postpone it.
segments.tr: لكن النتيجة الساحقة تخفي أيضاً مدى ضآلة ما تم حله فعلياً من الخلافات الجوهرية - فالقرار المستمر، بحكم تصميمه، لا ينهي معركة الميزانية بقدر ما يؤجلها.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Actually Does
segments.tr: ## ما الذي يفعله القرار المستمر فعلياً

segments.src: A CR is a stopgap spending bill that extends current funding levels for federal agencies past the start of a new fiscal year, buying lawmakers more time to negotiate full-year appropriations bills.
segments.tr: القرار المستمر (CR) هو مشروع قانون إنفاق مؤقت يمدد مستويات التمويل الحالية للوكالات الفيدرالية لما بعد بداية السنة المالية الجديدة، مما يمنح المشرعين مزيداً من الوقت للتفاوض على مشاريع قوانين المخصصات السنوية الكاملة.

segments.src: It doesn't set new spending priorities or resolve disputes over individual agency budgets; it simply freezes the status quo, typically with minor technical adjustments, for a set number of weeks or months.
segments.tr: إنه لا يحدد أولويات إنفاق جديدة ولا يحل النزاعات حول ميزانيات الوكالات الفردية؛ بل يقوم ببساطة بتجميد الوضع الراهن، عادةً مع تعديلات فنية طفيفة، لعدد محدد من الأسابيع أو الأشهر.

segments.src: This year's version extends funding into December, meaning the government avoids an immediate lapse but faces the same cliff again before the holidays — and, notably, just weeks before the 2026 midterm election season shifts into higher gear.
segments.tr: نسخة هذا العام تمدد التمويل حتى ديسمبر، مما يعني أن الحكومة تتجنب انهياراً فورياً لكنها تواجه نفس الهاوية مرة أخرى قبل العطلات - والأهم من ذلك، قبل أسابيع فقط من دخول موسم انتخابات التجديد النصفي لعام 2026 في مرحلة أكثر كثافة.

segments.src: ## Why December, Not Later
segments.tr: ## لماذا ديسمبر، وليس لاحقاً

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline wasn't accidental.
segments.tr: اختيار الموعد النهائي في ديسمبر لم يكن صدفة.

segments.src: It's long enough to avoid the optics of a shutdown heading into October, but short enough that leadership in both chambers retains leverage to force another round of negotiations before lawmakers leave for the holidays.
segments.tr: إنه طويل بما يكفي لتجنب تداعيات الإغلاق قبل أكتوبر، ولكنه قصير بما يكفي ليحتفظ القادة في كلا المجلسين بنفوذهم لفرض جولة أخرى من المفاوضات قبل أن يغادر المشرعون لقضاء العطلات.

segments.src: Punting past the midterms entirely would have required a much longer CR — an option that reportedly drew resistance from lawmakers who worry that funding agencies on autopilot for a full year erodes Congress's power of the purse and locks in spending levels that no longer reflect current priorities.
segments.tr: كان تأجيل الأمر لما بعد انتخابات التجديد النصفي بالكامل سيتطلب قراراً مستمراً أطول بكثير - وهو خيار قيل إنه واجه مقاومة من المشرعين الذين يخشون أن تمويل الوكالات بنظام الطيار الآلي لمدة عام كامل يؤدي إلى تآكل سلطة الكونغرس في تخصيص الأموال وتثبيت مستويات إنفاق لم تعد تعكس الأولويات الحالية.

segments.src: ## What Got Punted
segments.tr: ## ما الذي تم تأجيله

segments.src: The stopgap deal notably does not resolve several of the thornier disputes that have stalled full-year appropriations work:
segments.tr: من الجدير بالذكر أن الاتفاق المؤقت لا يحل العديد من النزاعات الأكثر تعقيداً التي عطلت عمل المخصصات السنوية الكاملة:

segments.src: - **Topline spending levels** — how much to allocate between defense and non-defense discretionary programs remains unsettled.
segments.tr: - **مستويات الإنفاق الإجمالية** — لا تزال مسألة مقدار ما يجب تخصيصه بين برامج الدفاع والبرامج التقديرية غير الدفاعية دون حل.

segments.src: - **Policy riders** — provisions attached to individual spending bills that touch on regulatory and agency-specific policy questions continue to be a sticking point between the chambers.
segments.tr: - **ملحقات السياسات** — لا تزال الأحكام المرفقة بمشاريع قوانين الإنفاق الفردية التي تتناول أسئلة تنظيمية وسياسات خاصة بالوكالات تشكل نقطة خلاف بين المجلسين.

segments.src: - **Individual agency allocations** — several of the twelve annual appropriations bills have not advanced far enough to reconcile House and Senate versions.
segments.tr: - **تخصيصات الوكالات الفردية** — لم تتقدم العديد من مشاريع قوانين المخصصات السنوية الاثني عشر بما يكفي للتوفيق بين نسختي مجلس النواب ومجلس الشيوخ.

segments.src: In other words, the CR keeps the lights on without answering any of the questions that made passing full-year funding difficult in the first place.
segments.tr: بمعنى آخر، يبقي القرار المستمر الأضواء مضاءة دون الإجابة على أي من الأسئلة التي جعلت تمرير التمويل السنوي الكامل أمراً صعباً في المقام الأول.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Backdrop
segments.tr: ## خلفية انتخابات التجديد النصفي

segments.src: Timing matters here.
segments.tr: التوقيت مهم هنا.

segments.src: A funding fight dragging into an election year raises the stakes for both parties, since a shutdown close to voting season tends to generate outsized political blame in whichever direction voters assign it.
segments.tr: إن معركة التمويل التي تمتد إلى عام انتخابي ترفع المخاطر لكلا الحزبين، حيث أن الإغلاق القريب من موسم التصويت يميل إلى توليد لوم سياسي هائل في أي اتجاه يوجهه الناخبون.

segments.src: By pushing the next deadline to December, lawmakers buy themselves a legislative session removed from the most intense phase of midterm campaigning, even as the underlying disputes — spending levels, riders, and individual agency budgets — will still need to be resolved eventually.
segments.tr: من خلال دفع الموعد النهائي التالي إلى ديسمبر، يشتري المشرعون لأنفسهم دورة تشريعية بعيدة عن المرحلة الأكثر كثافة من حملات التجديد النصفي، حتى مع بقاء النزاعات الأساسية - مستويات الإنفاق، والملحقات، وميزانيات الوكالات الفردية - بحاجة إلى حل في نهاية المطاف.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا سيحدث بعد ذلك

segments.src: Federal agencies, contractors, and grant recipients now have a period of funding certainty, but it's a conditional one.
segments.tr: تتمتع الوكالات الفيدرالية والمتعاقدون ومتلقو المنح الآن بفترة من اليقين بشأن التمويل، لكنه يقين مشروط.

segments.src: Budget offices across the government will continue operating under current-year funding levels rather than any newly negotiated amounts, and agencies generally avoid launching new initiatives during CR periods due to the funding uncertainty involved.
segments.tr: ستستمر مكاتب الميزانية في جميع أنحاء الحكومة في العمل بموجب مستويات تمويل العام الحالي بدلاً من أي مبالغ تم التفاوض عليها حديثاً، وعادة ما تتجنب الوكالات إطلاق مبادرات جديدة خلال فترات القرار المستمر بسبب عدم اليقين بشأن التمويل.

segments.src: For everyday observers, the practical takeaway is straightforward: no shutdown in October, but the same fight resumes in December, closer to the holidays and with the same unresolved questions about spending levels and policy riders still on the table.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمراقبين العاديين، فإن الخلاصة العملية واضحة: لا إغلاق في أكتوبر، لكن نفس المعركة ستستأنف في ديسمبر، بالقرب من العطلات ومع بقاء نفس الأسئلة غير المحلولة حول مستويات الإنفاق وملحقات السياسات مطروحة على الطاولة.

segments.src: Whether that translates into a smoother resolution or another down-to-the-wire scramble will depend on how much progress negotiators make on the individual appropriations bills in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: سواء كان ذلك سيترجم إلى حل أكثر سلاسة أو تدافعاً آخر في اللحظة الأخيرة، سيعتمد على مقدار التقدم الذي يحرزه المفاوضون بشأن مشاريع قوانين المخصصات الفردية في الأسابيع المقبلة.

fr.title: 90-6 et une échéance évitée : dans les coulisses de l'accord provisoire du Congrès pour éviter un shutdown en octobre

segments.src: With federal funding under the FY2026 appropriations calendar set to expire on September 30, Congress has once again reached for its most familiar budget tool: the continuing resolution.
segments.tr: Alors que le financement fédéral prévu par le calendrier des crédits de l'exercice 2026 doit expirer le 30 septembre, le Congrès a de nouveau eu recours à son outil budgétaire le plus familier : la résolution continue (continuing resolution).

segments.src: A bipartisan measure to keep federal agencies funded into December cleared the Senate by a lopsided 90-6 margin before moving to the House, averting an October 1 shutdown that both parties said they wanted to avoid heading into a politically sensitive stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: Une mesure bipartisane visant à maintenir le financement des agences fédérales jusqu'en décembre a été adoptée par le Sénat avec une large majorité de 90 voix contre 6 avant d'être transmise à la Chambre, évitant ainsi un shutdown le 1er octobre que les deux partis disaient vouloir éviter à l'approche d'une période politiquement sensible du calendrier.

segments.src: The vote tally itself tells a story.
segments.tr: Le résultat du vote en lui-même est révélateur.

segments.src: A 90-6 outcome in a chamber known for narrow, party-line splits signals that neither side wanted its fingerprints on a shutdown this time around.
segments.tr: Un résultat de 90-6 dans une chambre connue pour ses divisions partisanes étroites indique qu'aucune des deux parties ne voulait voir ses empreintes digitales sur un shutdown cette fois-ci.

segments.src: But the lopsided count also masks how little the underlying disagreements have actually been resolved — a continuing resolution, by design, doesn't settle a budget fight so much as postpone it.
segments.tr: Mais ce score déséquilibré masque également le peu de progrès réel sur les désaccords sous-jacents — une résolution continue, par définition, ne règle pas un conflit budgétaire, elle le reporte.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Ce que fait réellement une résolution continue

segments.src: A CR is a stopgap spending bill that extends current funding levels for federal agencies past the start of a new fiscal year, buying lawmakers more time to negotiate full-year appropriations bills.
segments.tr: Une CR est une loi de dépenses provisoire qui prolonge les niveaux de financement actuels des agences fédérales au-delà du début d'un nouvel exercice fiscal, offrant aux législateurs plus de temps pour négocier les lois de crédits annuelles.

segments.src: It doesn't set new spending priorities or resolve disputes over individual agency budgets; it simply freezes the status quo, typically with minor technical adjustments, for a set number of weeks or months.
segments.tr: Elle ne fixe pas de nouvelles priorités de dépenses et ne résout pas les différends concernant les budgets individuels des agences ; elle gèle simplement le statu quo, généralement avec des ajustements techniques mineurs, pour un nombre défini de semaines ou de mois.

segments.src: This year's version extends funding into December, meaning the government avoids an immediate lapse but faces the same cliff again before the holidays — and, notably, just weeks before the 2026 midterm election season shifts into higher gear.
segments.tr: La version de cette année prolonge le financement jusqu'en décembre, ce qui signifie que le gouvernement évite une interruption immédiate mais sera confronté à la même falaise avant les vacances — et, surtout, quelques semaines seulement avant que la saison des élections de mi-mandat de 2026 ne passe à la vitesse supérieure.

segments.src: ## Why December, Not Later
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi décembre, et pas plus tard

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline wasn't accidental.
segments.tr: Le choix d'une échéance en décembre n'était pas accidentel.

segments.src: It's long enough to avoid the optics of a shutdown heading into October, but short enough that leadership in both chambers retains leverage to force another round of negotiations before lawmakers leave for the holidays.
segments.tr: C'est assez long pour éviter l'image d'un shutdown à l'approche d'octobre, mais assez court pour que les dirigeants des deux chambres conservent un levier pour forcer une nouvelle série de négociations avant que les législateurs ne partent en vacances.

segments.src: Punting past the midterms entirely would have required a much longer CR — an option that reportedly drew resistance from lawmakers who worry that funding agencies on autopilot for a full year erodes Congress's power of the purse and locks in spending levels that no longer reflect current priorities.
segments.tr: Reporter l'échéance après les élections de mi-mandat aurait nécessité une CR beaucoup plus longue — une option qui aurait suscité la résistance des législateurs craignant que le financement des agences en pilotage automatique pendant une année entière n'érode le pouvoir de la bourse du Congrès et ne verrouille des niveaux de dépenses qui ne reflètent plus les priorités actuelles.

segments.src: ## What Got Punted
segments.tr: ## Ce qui a été reporté

segments.src: The stopgap deal notably does not resolve several of the thornier disputes that have stalled full-year appropriations work:
segments.tr: L'accord provisoire ne résout notamment pas plusieurs des différends les plus épineux qui ont bloqué les travaux sur les crédits annuels :

segments.src: - **Topline spending levels** — how much to allocate between defense and non-defense discretionary programs remains unsettled.
segments.tr: - **Niveaux de dépenses globaux** — la répartition des fonds entre les programmes de défense et les programmes discrétionnaires non liés à la défense reste en suspens.

segments.src: - **Policy riders** — provisions attached to individual spending bills that touch on regulatory and agency-specific policy questions continue to be a sticking point between the chambers.
segments.tr: - **Cavaliers législatifs (policy riders)** — les dispositions ajoutées aux lois de dépenses individuelles qui touchent à des questions de politique réglementaire et spécifique aux agences continuent d'être un point de friction entre les chambres.

segments.src: - **Individual agency allocations** — several of the twelve annual appropriations bills have not advanced far enough to reconcile House and Senate versions.
segments.tr: - **Allocations individuelles des agences** — plusieurs des douze lois de crédits annuelles n'ont pas suffisamment progressé pour concilier les versions de la Chambre et du Sénat.

segments.src: In other words, the CR keeps the lights on without answering any of the questions that made passing full-year funding difficult in the first place.
segments.tr: En d'autres termes, la CR maintient les lumières allumées sans répondre à aucune des questions qui rendaient le vote du financement annuel difficile en premier lieu.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Backdrop
segments.tr: ## Le contexte des élections de mi-mandat

segments.src: Timing matters here.
segments.tr: Le timing est important ici.

segments.src: A funding fight dragging into an election year raises the stakes for both parties, since a shutdown close to voting season tends to generate outsized political blame in whichever direction voters assign it.
segments.tr: Un conflit budgétaire qui s'éternise jusqu'à une année électorale augmente les enjeux pour les deux partis, car un shutdown proche de la saison électorale a tendance à générer un blâme politique démesuré, quelle que soit la direction dans laquelle les électeurs l'attribuent.

segments.src: By pushing the next deadline to December, lawmakers buy themselves a legislative session removed from the most intense phase of midterm campaigning, even as the underlying disputes — spending levels, riders, and individual agency budgets — will still need to be resolved eventually.
segments.tr: En repoussant la prochaine échéance à décembre, les législateurs s'offrent une session législative éloignée de la phase la plus intense de la campagne de mi-mandat, même si les différends sous-jacents — niveaux de dépenses, cavaliers et budgets individuels des agences — devront toujours être résolus à terme.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelle est la suite

segments.src: Federal agencies, contractors, and grant recipients now have a period of funding certainty, but it's a conditional one.
segments.tr: Les agences fédérales, les entrepreneurs et les bénéficiaires de subventions disposent désormais d'une période de certitude de financement, mais elle est conditionnelle.

segments.src: Budget offices across the government will continue operating under current-year funding levels rather than any newly negotiated amounts, and agencies generally avoid launching new initiatives during CR periods due to the funding uncertainty involved.
segments.tr: Les bureaux budgétaires du gouvernement continueront de fonctionner selon les niveaux de financement de l'année en cours plutôt que selon des montants nouvellement négociés, et les agences évitent généralement de lancer de nouvelles initiatives pendant les périodes de CR en raison de l'incertitude liée au financement.

segments.src: For everyday observers, the practical takeaway is straightforward: no shutdown in October, but the same fight resumes in December, closer to the holidays and with the same unresolved questions about spending levels and policy riders still on the table.
segments.tr: Pour les observateurs quotidiens, la conclusion pratique est simple : pas de shutdown en octobre, mais le même combat reprendra en décembre, plus près des vacances et avec les mêmes questions non résolues sur les niveaux de dépenses et les cavaliers politiques toujours sur la table.

segments.src: Whether that translates into a smoother resolution or another down-to-the-wire scramble will depend on how much progress negotiators make on the individual appropriations bills in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: La question de savoir si cela se traduira par une résolution plus fluide ou par une nouvelle course contre la montre dépendra des progrès réalisés par les négociateurs sur les lois de crédits individuelles dans les semaines à venir.

pt.title: 90-6 e um prazo evitado: por dentro do acordo provisório do Congresso para evitar uma paralisação em outubro

segments.src: With federal funding under the FY2026 appropriations calendar set to expire on September 30, Congress has once again reached for its most familiar budget tool: the continuing resolution.
segments.tr: Com o financiamento federal sob o calendário de dotações do ano fiscal de 2026 previsto para expirar em 30 de setembro, o Congresso recorreu mais uma vez à sua ferramenta orçamentária mais familiar: a resolução contínua.

segments.src: A bipartisan measure to keep federal agencies funded into December cleared the Senate by a lopsided 90-6 margin before moving to the House, averting an October 1 shutdown that both parties said they wanted to avoid heading into a politically sensitive stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: Uma medida bipartidária para manter as agências federais financiadas até dezembro foi aprovada no Senado por uma margem desigual de 90-6 antes de seguir para a Câmara, evitando uma paralisação em 1º de outubro que ambos os partidos disseram querer evitar antes de um período politicamente sensível do calendário.

segments.src: The vote tally itself tells a story.
segments.tr: A contagem dos votos por si só conta uma história.

segments.src: A 90-6 outcome in a chamber known for narrow, party-line splits signals that neither side wanted its fingerprints on a shutdown this time around.
segments.tr: Um resultado de 90-6 em uma câmara conhecida por divisões estreitas e partidárias sinaliza que nenhum dos lados queria suas digitais em uma paralisação desta vez.

segments.src: But the lopsided count also masks how little the underlying disagreements have actually been resolved — a continuing resolution, by design, doesn't settle a budget fight so much as postpone it.
segments.tr: Mas a contagem desigual também mascara o quão pouco as divergências subjacentes foram realmente resolvidas — uma resolução contínua, por definição, não resolve uma disputa orçamentária, mas sim a adia.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Actually Does
segments.tr: ## O que uma Resolução Contínua realmente faz

segments.src: A CR is a stopgap spending bill that extends current funding levels for federal agencies past the start of a new fiscal year, buying lawmakers more time to negotiate full-year appropriations bills.
segments.tr: Uma CR é um projeto de lei de gastos provisório que estende os níveis atuais de financiamento para agências federais além do início de um novo ano fiscal, comprando mais tempo para os legisladores negociarem projetos de lei de dotações para o ano todo.

segments.src: It doesn't set new spending priorities or resolve disputes over individual agency budgets; it simply freezes the status quo, typically with minor technical adjustments, for a set number of weeks or months.
segments.tr: Ela não estabelece novas prioridades de gastos nem resolve disputas sobre orçamentos de agências individuais; ela simplesmente congela o status quo, normalmente com pequenos ajustes técnicos, por um número definido de semanas ou meses.

segments.src: This year's version extends funding into December, meaning the government avoids an immediate lapse but faces the same cliff again before the holidays — and, notably, just weeks before the 2026 midterm election season shifts into higher gear.
segments.tr: A versão deste ano estende o financiamento até dezembro, o que significa que o governo evita uma interrupção imediata, mas enfrenta o mesmo precipício novamente antes das festas de fim de ano — e, notavelmente, apenas semanas antes da temporada das eleições de meio de mandato de 2026 ganhar força.

segments.src: ## Why December, Not Later
segments.tr: ## Por que dezembro, e não depois

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline wasn't accidental.
segments.tr: A escolha de um prazo em dezembro não foi acidental.

segments.src: It's long enough to avoid the optics of a shutdown heading into October, but short enough that leadership in both chambers retains leverage to force another round of negotiations before lawmakers leave for the holidays.
segments.tr: É tempo suficiente para evitar a imagem de uma paralisação antes de outubro, mas curto o suficiente para que a liderança em ambas as câmaras mantenha influência para forçar outra rodada de negociações antes que os legisladores saiam para as festas de fim de ano.

segments.src: Punting past the midterms entirely would have required a much longer CR — an option that reportedly drew resistance from lawmakers who worry that funding agencies on autopilot for a full year erodes Congress's power of the purse and locks in spending levels that no longer reflect current priorities.
segments.tr: Adiar completamente para depois das eleições de meio de mandato teria exigido uma CR muito mais longa — uma opção que, segundo relatos, gerou resistência de legisladores que temem que financiar agências no piloto automático por um ano inteiro erode o poder da bolsa do Congresso e fixa níveis de gastos que não refletem mais as prioridades atuais.

segments.src: ## What Got Punted
segments.tr: ## O que foi adiado

segments.src: The stopgap deal notably does not resolve several of the thornier disputes that have stalled full-year appropriations work:
segments.tr: O acordo provisório notavelmente não resolve várias das disputas mais espinhosas que paralisaram o trabalho de dotações para o ano todo:

segments.src: - **Topline spending levels** — how much to allocate between defense and non-defense discretionary programs remains unsettled.
segments.tr: - **Níveis globais de gastos** — quanto alocar entre programas discricionários de defesa e não defesa permanece sem solução.

segments.src: - **Policy riders** — provisions attached to individual spending bills that touch on regulatory and agency-specific policy questions continue to be a sticking point between the chambers.
segments.tr: - **Cláusulas políticas (riders)** — disposições anexadas a projetos de lei de gastos individuais que tocam em questões regulatórias e de política específica de agências continuam sendo um ponto de atrito entre as câmaras.

segments.src: - **Individual agency allocations** — several of the twelve annual appropriations bills have not advanced far enough to reconcile House and Senate versions.
segments.tr: - **Alocações de agências individuais** — vários dos doze projetos de lei de dotações anuais não avançaram o suficiente para reconciliar as versões da Câmara e do Senado.

segments.src: In other words, the CR keeps the lights on without answering any of the questions that made passing full-year funding difficult in the first place.
segments.tr: Em outras palavras, a CR mantém as luzes acesas sem responder a nenhuma das perguntas que tornaram a aprovação do financiamento para o ano todo difícil em primeiro lugar.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Backdrop
segments.tr: ## O cenário das eleições de meio de mandato

segments.src: Timing matters here.
segments.tr: O momento importa aqui.

segments.src: A funding fight dragging into an election year raises the stakes for both parties, since a shutdown close to voting season tends to generate outsized political blame in whichever direction voters assign it.
segments.tr: Uma disputa por financiamento que se arrasta para um ano eleitoral aumenta as apostas para ambos os partidos, já que uma paralisação próxima à temporada de votação tende a gerar uma culpa política desproporcional na direção que os eleitores atribuírem.

segments.src: By pushing the next deadline to December, lawmakers buy themselves a legislative session removed from the most intense phase of midterm campaigning, even as the underlying disputes — spending levels, riders, and individual agency budgets — will still need to be resolved eventually.
segments.tr: Ao empurrar o próximo prazo para dezembro, os legisladores ganham uma sessão legislativa afastada da fase mais intensa da campanha de meio de mandato, mesmo que as disputas subjacentes — níveis de gastos, cláusulas políticas e orçamentos de agências individuais — ainda precisem ser resolvidas eventualmente.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## O que vem a seguir

segments.src: Federal agencies, contractors, and grant recipients now have a period of funding certainty, but it's a conditional one.
segments.tr: Agências federais, contratados e beneficiários de subsídios agora têm um período de certeza de financiamento, mas é condicional.

segments.src: Budget offices across the government will continue operating under current-year funding levels rather than any newly negotiated amounts, and agencies generally avoid launching new initiatives during CR periods due to the funding uncertainty involved.
segments.tr: Os escritórios de orçamento em todo o governo continuarão operando sob os níveis de financiamento do ano atual, em vez de quaisquer valores recém-negociados, e as agências geralmente evitam lançar novas iniciativas durante os períodos de CR devido à incerteza de financiamento envolvida.

segments.src: For everyday observers, the practical takeaway is straightforward: no shutdown in October, but the same fight resumes in December, closer to the holidays and with the same unresolved questions about spending levels and policy riders still on the table.
segments.tr: Para os observadores do dia a dia, a conclusão prática é direta: sem paralisação em outubro, mas a mesma luta recomeça em dezembro, mais perto das festas de fim de ano e com as mesmas questões não resolvidas sobre níveis de gastos e cláusulas políticas ainda na mesa.

segments.src: Whether that translates into a smoother resolution or another down-to-the-wire scramble will depend on how much progress negotiators make on the individual appropriations bills in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Se isso se traduzirá em uma resolução mais tranquila ou em outra correria de última hora dependerá de quanto progresso os negociadores farão nos projetos de lei de dotações individuais nas próximas semanas.

in.title: 90-6 dan Satu Tenggat Waktu yang Dihindari: Di Balik Kesepakatan Sementara Kongres untuk Mencegah Penutupan Pemerintahan Bulan Oktober

segments.src: With federal funding under the FY2026 appropriations calendar set to expire on September 30, Congress has once again reached for its most familiar budget tool: the continuing resolution.
segments.tr: Dengan pendanaan federal di bawah kalender anggaran FY2026 yang dijadwalkan berakhir pada 30 September, Kongres sekali lagi menggunakan alat anggaran yang paling familier: resolusi lanjutan.

segments.src: A bipartisan measure to keep federal agencies funded into December cleared the Senate by a lopsided 90-6 margin before moving to the House, averting an October 1 shutdown that both parties said they wanted to avoid heading into a politically sensitive stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: Sebuah langkah bipartisan untuk menjaga agar badan-badan federal tetap didanai hingga bulan Desember berhasil disahkan oleh Senat dengan selisih suara telak 90-6 sebelum dibawa ke DPR, guna menghindari penutupan pemerintahan pada 1 Oktober yang oleh kedua partai disebut ingin dihindari menjelang periode kalender yang sensitif secara politik.

segments.src: The vote tally itself tells a story.
segments.tr: Perolehan suara itu sendiri menceritakan sebuah kisah.

segments.src: A 90-6 outcome in a chamber known for narrow, party-line splits signals that neither side wanted its fingerprints on a shutdown this time around.
segments.tr: Hasil 90-6 di ruang sidang yang terkenal dengan perpecahan tipis menurut garis partai mengisyaratkan bahwa tidak ada satupun pihak yang ingin keterlibatannya tercatat dalam penutupan pemerintahan kali ini.

segments.src: But the lopsided count also masks how little the underlying disagreements have actually been resolved — a continuing resolution, by design, doesn't settle a budget fight so much as postpone it.
segments.tr: Namun, angka yang timpang tersebut juga menutupi betapa kecilnya perbedaan pendapat mendasar yang benar-benar telah diselesaikan — sebuah resolusi lanjutan, berdasarkan desainnya, tidak menyelesaikan pertarungan anggaran melainkan menundanya.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Sebenarnya Dilakukan oleh Resolusi Lanjutan

segments.src: A CR is a stopgap spending bill that extends current funding levels for federal agencies past the start of a new fiscal year, buying lawmakers more time to negotiate full-year appropriations bills.
segments.tr: CR adalah RUU pengeluaran sementara yang memperpanjang tingkat pendanaan saat ini untuk badan-badan federal melewati awal tahun fiskal baru, memberi para pembuat undang-undang lebih banyak waktu untuk menegosiasikan RUU alokasi setahun penuh.

segments.src: It doesn't set new spending priorities or resolve disputes over individual agency budgets; it simply freezes the status quo, typically with minor technical adjustments, for a set number of weeks or months.
segments.tr: Langkah ini tidak menetapkan prioritas pengeluaran baru atau menyelesaikan sengketa atas anggaran badan individual; ini hanya membekukan status quo, biasanya dengan penyesuaian teknis minor, untuk sejumlah minggu atau bulan yang telah ditentukan.

segments.src: This year's version extends funding into December, meaning the government avoids an immediate lapse but faces the same cliff again before the holidays — and, notably, just weeks before the 2026 midterm election season shifts into higher gear.
segments.tr: Versi tahun ini memperpanjang pendanaan hingga Desember, yang berarti pemerintah menghindari kelangkaan segera tetapi menghadapi tebing yang sama lagi sebelum liburan — dan, yang perlu dicatat, hanya beberapa minggu sebelum musim pemilihan paruh waktu 2026 memasuki gigi yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: ## Why December, Not Later
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Desember, Bukan Nanti

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline wasn't accidental.
segments.tr: Pilihan tenggat waktu bulan Desember bukanlah suatu kebetulan.

segments.src: It's long enough to avoid the optics of a shutdown heading into October, but short enough that leadership in both chambers retains leverage to force another round of negotiations before lawmakers leave for the holidays.
segments.tr: Waktu ini cukup panjang untuk menghindari citra buruk penutupan pemerintahan menjelang Oktober, tetapi cukup singkat sehingga pimpinan di kedua kamar tetap memiliki daya tawar untuk memaksa putaran negosiasi lain sebelum para pembuat undang-undang cuti untuk liburan.

segments.src: Punting past the midterms entirely would have required a much longer CR — an option that reportedly drew resistance from lawmakers who worry that funding agencies on autopilot for a full year erodes Congress's power of the purse and locks in spending levels that no longer reflect current priorities.
segments.tr: Menunda sepenuhnya melewati pemilu paruh waktu akan membutuhkan CR yang jauh lebih panjang — sebuah opsi yang kabarnya mendapat perlawanan dari para pembuat undang-undang yang khawatir bahwa mendanai badan-badan dengan mode otomatis selama setahun penuh akan mengikis kekuasaan anggaran Kongres dan mengunci tingkat pengeluaran yang tidak lagi mencerminkan prioritas saat ini.

segments.src: ## What Got Punted
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Ditunda

segments.src: The stopgap deal notably does not resolve several of the thornier disputes that have stalled full-year appropriations work:
segments.tr: Kesepakatan sementara ini terutama tidak menyelesaikan beberapa sengketa yang lebih rumit yang telah menghambat pekerjaan alokasi setahun penuh:

segments.src: - **Topline spending levels** — how much to allocate between defense and non-defense discretionary programs remains unsettled.
segments.tr: - **Tingkat pengeluaran tertinggi** — berapa banyak yang harus dialokasikan antara program diskresioner pertahanan dan non-pertahanan masih belum diselesaikan.

segments.src: - **Policy riders** — provisions attached to individual spending bills that touch on regulatory and agency-specific policy questions continue to be a sticking point between the chambers.
segments.tr: - **Ketentuan tambahan kebijakan** — ketentuan yang dilampirkan pada RUU pengeluaran individual yang menyentuh pertanyaan kebijakan peraturan dan spesifik badan terus menjadi batu sandungan antara kedua kamar.

segments.src: - **Individual agency allocations** — several of the twelve annual appropriations bills have not advanced far enough to reconcile House and Senate versions.
segments.tr: - **Alokasi badan individual** — beberapa dari dua belas RUU alokasi tahunan belum maju cukup jauh untuk mendamaikan versi DPR dan Senat.

segments.src: In other words, the CR keeps the lights on without answering any of the questions that made passing full-year funding difficult in the first place.
segments.tr: Dengan kata lain, CR menjaga lampu tetap menyala tanpa menjawab satupun pertanyaan yang membuat pengesahan pendanaan setahun penuh menjadi sulit sejak awal.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Backdrop
segments.tr: ## Latar Belakang Pemilu Paruh Waktu

segments.src: Timing matters here.
segments.tr: Waktu sangat penting di sini.

segments.src: A funding fight dragging into an election year raises the stakes for both parties, since a shutdown close to voting season tends to generate outsized political blame in whichever direction voters assign it.
segments.tr: Pertarungan pendanaan yang menyeret ke tahun pemilu meningkatkan taruhan bagi kedua partai, karena penutupan pemerintahan yang dekat dengan musim pemungutan suara cenderung menghasilkan kesalahan politik yang luar biasa ke arah mana pun yang diberikan oleh para pemilih.

segments.src: By pushing the next deadline to December, lawmakers buy themselves a legislative session removed from the most intense phase of midterm campaigning, even as the underlying disputes — spending levels, riders, and individual agency budgets — will still need to be resolved eventually.
segments.tr: Dengan mendorong tenggat waktu berikutnya ke bulan Desember, para pembuat undang-undang membelikan diri mereka sesi legislatif yang terhindar dari fase kampanye pemilu paruh waktu yang paling intens, bahkan ketika sengketa yang mendasarinya — tingkat pengeluaran, ketentuan tambahan, dan anggaran badan individual — masih perlu diselesaikan pada akhirnya.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: Federal agencies, contractors, and grant recipients now have a period of funding certainty, but it's a conditional one.
segments.tr: Badan-badan federal, kontraktor, dan penerima hibah sekarang memiliki periode kepastian pendanaan, tetapi ini adalah kepastian yang bersyarat.

segments.src: Budget offices across the government will continue operating under current-year funding levels rather than any newly negotiated amounts, and agencies generally avoid launching new initiatives during CR periods due to the funding uncertainty involved.
segments.tr: Kantor anggaran di seluruh pemerintahan akan terus beroperasi di bawah tingkat pendanaan tahun berjalan daripada jumlah yang baru negosiasikan, dan badan-badan umumnya menghindari meluncurkan inisiatif baru selama periode CR karena ketidakpastian pendanaan yang terlibat.

segments.src: For everyday observers, the practical takeaway is straightforward: no shutdown in October, but the same fight resumes in December, closer to the holidays and with the same unresolved questions about spending levels and policy riders still on the table.
segments.tr: Bagi pengamat sehari-hari, kesimpulan praktisnya sangatlah mudah: tidak ada penutupan pemerintahan di bulan Oktober, tetapi pertarungan yang sama akan dilanjutkan pada bulan Desember, lebih dekat ke liburan dan dengan pertanyaan-pertanyaan yang sama mengenai tingkat pengeluaran dan ketentuan kebijakan yang belum terselesaikan yang masih ada di atas meja.

segments.src: Whether that translates into a smoother resolution or another down-to-the-wire scramble will depend on how much progress negotiators make on the individual appropriations bills in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Apakah hal itu diterjemahkan menjadi resolusi yang lebih mulus atau perjuangan menit-menit akhir lainnya akan bergantung pada seberapa banyak kemajuan yang dibuat oleh para negosiator pada RUU alokasi individual dalam beberapa minggu ke depan.

ja.title: 90対6と回避された1つの期限：10月の閉鎖を避けるための議会の繋ぎ予算合意の舞台裏

segments.src: With federal funding under the FY2026 appropriations calendar set to expire on September 30, Congress has once again reached for its most familiar budget tool: the continuing resolution.
segments.tr: FY2026歳出スケジュールに基づく連邦政府の資金提供が9月30日に失効することになり、議会は再び最も使い慣れた予算ツールである継続決議案（つなぎ予算）に頼ることになった。

segments.src: A bipartisan measure to keep federal agencies funded into December cleared the Senate by a lopsided 90-6 margin before moving to the House, averting an October 1 shutdown that both parties said they wanted to avoid heading into a politically sensitive stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: 12月まで連邦政府機関への資金提供を維持するための超党派の法案は、上院で90対6という大差で可決された後、下院へと送られ、政治的に敏感な時期を迎えるにあたって両党が回避したいと表明していた10月1日の政府閉鎖を防いだ。

segments.src: The vote tally itself tells a story.
segments.tr: 投票結果そのものが一つの物語を語っている。

segments.src: A 90-6 outcome in a chamber known for narrow, party-line splits signals that neither side wanted its fingerprints on a shutdown this time around.
segments.tr: 僅差の党派別対立で知られる議会において90対6という結果となったことは、今回はどちらの陣営も政府閉鎖の責任を負いたくなかったことを示している。

segments.src: But the lopsided count also masks how little the underlying disagreements have actually been resolved — a continuing resolution, by design, doesn't settle a budget fight so much as postpone it.
segments.tr: しかし、この大差での可決は、根本的な意見の不一致が実際にはどれほど解決されていないかを覆い隠すものでもある。継続決議案は、その性質上、予算闘争を解決するというよりも先送りするものだからだ。

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Actually Does
segments.tr: ## 継続決議案が実際に意味するもの

segments.src: A CR is a stopgap spending bill that extends current funding levels for federal agencies past the start of a new fiscal year, buying lawmakers more time to negotiate full-year appropriations bills.
segments.tr: CR（継続決議案）とは、新年度の開始後も連邦機関の現在の資金水準を維持し、議員が通年予算案を交渉するための時間を稼ぐための一時的な支出法案である。

segments.src: It doesn't set new spending priorities or resolve disputes over individual agency budgets; it simply freezes the status quo, typically with minor technical adjustments, for a set number of weeks or months.
segments.tr: これは新たな支出優先順位を設定したり、個別の機関の予算に関する争いを解決したりするものではなく、わずかな技術的調整を伴いつつ、一定の週数または月数にわたり単に現状を凍結するものである。

segments.src: This year's version extends funding into December, meaning the government avoids an immediate lapse but faces the same cliff again before the holidays — and, notably, just weeks before the 2026 midterm election season shifts into higher gear.
segments.tr: 今年の案では資金提供が12月まで延長されるため、政府は差し迫った失効を回避できるものの、休日の前に再び同じ崖っぷちに直面することになる。特筆すべきことに、それは2026年中間選挙シーズンが本格化するわずか数週間前のことである。

segments.src: ## Why December, Not Later
segments.tr: ## なぜ後回しではなく12月なのか

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline wasn't accidental.
segments.tr: 12月の期限が選ばれたのは偶然ではない。

segments.src: It's long enough to avoid the optics of a shutdown heading into October, but short enough that leadership in both chambers retains leverage to force another round of negotiations before lawmakers leave for the holidays.
segments.tr: 10月に向けた政府閉鎖という見栄えの悪さを避けるのに十分な長さでありながら、議員たちが休暇に入る前にさらなる交渉のラウンドを強いるための影響力を両院の指導部が維持できるだけの短さでもある。

segments.src: Punting past the midterms entirely would have required a much longer CR — an option that reportedly drew resistance from lawmakers who worry that funding agencies on autopilot for a full year erodes Congress's power of the purse and locks in spending levels that no longer reflect current priorities.
segments.tr: 中間選挙後まで完全に先送りするには、はるかに長期のCRが必要であっただろう。報道によると、この選択肢は、機関の自動操縦的な資金提供を1年間続けると議会の予算編成権が損なわれ、もはや現在の優先順位を反映しなくなった支出水準が固定化されてしまうと懸念する議員たちからの抵抗を招いたとされる。

segments.src: ## What Got Punted
segments.tr: ## 先送りされた事項

segments.src: The stopgap deal notably does not resolve several of the thornier disputes that have stalled full-year appropriations work:
segments.tr: この繋ぎ予算の合意では、通年予算案の審議を停滞させてきたより困難な争点のいくつかが解決されていないことが特筆される：

segments.src: - **Topline spending levels** — how much to allocate between defense and non-defense discretionary programs remains unsettled.
segments.tr: - **トップラインの支出水準** — 防衛費と非防衛裁量的プログラムの間でどれだけの額を割り当てるかという問題は未解決のままである。

segments.src: - **Policy riders** — provisions attached to individual spending bills that touch on regulatory and agency-specific policy questions continue to be a sticking point between the chambers.
segments.tr: - **政策ライダー** — 規制や機関特有の政策問題に関わる個別の支出法案に付随する条項は、両院間で意見が対立するポイントであり続けている。

segments.src: - **Individual agency allocations** — several of the twelve annual appropriations bills have not advanced far enough to reconcile House and Senate versions.
segments.tr: - **個別の機関への配分** — 年間12本の歳出法案のうちいくつかは、下院案と上院案を調停するのに十分なほど審議が進んでいない。

segments.src: In other words, the CR keeps the lights on without answering any of the questions that made passing full-year funding difficult in the first place.
segments.tr: 言い換えれば、CRは、通年予算の成立をそもそも困難にしていたどの疑問にも答えることなく、ただ明かりを灯し続けているに過ぎない。

segments.src: ## The Midterm Backdrop
segments.tr: ## 中間選挙の背景

segments.src: Timing matters here.
segments.tr: ここではタイミングが重要である。

segments.src: A funding fight dragging into an election year raises the stakes for both parties, since a shutdown close to voting season tends to generate outsized political blame in whichever direction voters assign it.
segments.tr: 選挙イヤーにまで予算闘争が長引けば、両党にとって賭け金が高くなる。投票シーズンに近い時期の政府閉鎖は、有権者がどちらの方向に責任を帰するにせよ、圧倒的な政治的非難を生む傾向があるからだ。

segments.src: By pushing the next deadline to December, lawmakers buy themselves a legislative session removed from the most intense phase of midterm campaigning, even as the underlying disputes — spending levels, riders, and individual agency budgets — will still need to be resolved eventually.
segments.tr: 次の期限を12月に押し戻すことで、議員たちは中間選挙運動の最も激しい局面から切り離された立法セッションを手に入れることになるが、支出水準、ライダー、個別の機関の予算といった根本的な対立は、最終的には依然として解決される必要がある。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 次に何が起きるのか

segments.src: Federal agencies, contractors, and grant recipients now have a period of funding certainty, but it's a conditional one.
segments.tr: 連邦政府機関、請負業者、補助金受給者は現在、資金提供の確実性を得ているが、それは条件付きのものである。

segments.src: Budget offices across the government will continue operating under current-year funding levels rather than any newly negotiated amounts, and agencies generally avoid launching new initiatives during CR periods due to the funding uncertainty involved.
segments.tr: 政府全体の予算事務所は、新しく交渉された金額ではなく、今年度の資金水準の下で運営を継続することになり、機関は伴う資金の不確実性ゆえにCR期間中の新しいイニシアチブの立ち上げを一般的に避けることになる。

segments.src: For everyday observers, the practical takeaway is straightforward: no shutdown in October, but the same fight resumes in December, closer to the holidays and with the same unresolved questions about spending levels and policy riders still on the table.
segments.tr: 一般的な観察者にとって、実用的な要点はシンプルである。10月に政府閉鎖はないが、同じ戦いが12月に再開され、休日に近づいた時期に、支出水準や政策ライダーに関する同じ未解決の疑問がテーブルの上に残されたままとなる。

segments.src: Whether that translates into a smoother resolution or another down-to-the-wire scramble will depend on how much progress negotiators make on the individual appropriations bills in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: それがよりスムーズな解決につながるのか、それとも再び期限ギリギリの混乱となるのかは、今後の数週間で交渉担当者が個別の歳出法案に関してどれだけ進展を見せるかにかかっている。

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Was eine Übergangsfinanzierung tatsächlich bewirkt

segments.src: A CR is a stopgap spending bill that extends current funding levels for federal agencies past the start of a new fiscal year, buying lawmakers more time to negotiate full-year appropriations bills.
segments.tr: Eine CR ist ein vorübergehendes Ausgabengesetz, das die aktuellen Finanzierungsebenen für Bundesbehörden über den Beginn eines neuen Geschäftsjahres hinaus verlängert, um den Abgeordneten mehr Zeit für die Aushandlung von Ganzjahres-Ausgabengesetzen zu verschaffen.

segments.src: It doesn't set new spending priorities or resolve disputes over individual agency budgets; it simply freezes the status quo, typically with minor technical adjustments, for a set number of weeks or months.
segments.tr: Sie legt keine neuen Ausgabenprioritäten fest und löst keine Streitigkeiten über die Budgets einzelner Behörden; sie friert lediglich den Status quo ein, typischerweise mit geringfügigen technischen Anpassungen, für eine festgelegte Anzahl von Wochen oder Monaten.

segments.src: This year's version extends funding into December, meaning the government avoids an immediate lapse but faces the same cliff again before the holidays — and, notably, just weeks before the 2026 midterm election season shifts into higher gear.
segments.tr: Die diesjährige Version verlängert die Finanzierung bis in den Dezember, was bedeutet, dass die Regierung eine unmittelbare Unterbrechung vermeidet, aber vor den Feiertagen erneut vor demselben Abgrund steht — und das bemerkenswerterweise nur wenige Wochen bevor die Zwischenwahl-Saison 2026 richtig an Fahrt aufnimmt.

segments.src: ## Why December, Not Later
segments.tr: ## Warum Dezember und nicht später

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline wasn't accidental.
segments.tr: Die Wahl einer Frist im Dezember war kein Zufall.

segments.src: It's long enough to avoid the optics of a shutdown heading into October, but short enough that leadership in both chambers retains leverage to force another round of negotiations before lawmakers leave for the holidays.
segments.tr: Sie ist lang genug, um die optische Wirkung eines Shutdowns kurz vor Oktober zu vermeiden, aber kurz genug, damit die Führung beider Kammern ein Druckmittel behält, um eine weitere Verhandlungsrunde zu erzwingen, bevor die Abgeordneten in die Feiertage gehen.

segments.src: Punting past the midterms entirely would have required a much longer CR — an option that reportedly drew resistance from lawmakers who worry that funding agencies on autopilot for a full year erodes Congress's power of the purse and locks in spending levels that no longer reflect current priorities.
segments.tr: Ein Aufschub über die Zwischenwahlen hinaus hätte eine wesentlich längere CR erfordert — eine Option, die Berichten zufolge auf Widerstand bei Abgeordneten stieß, die befürchten, dass eine Finanzierung der Behörden auf Autopilot für ein ganzes Jahr das Budgetrecht des Kongresses untergräbt und Ausgabenniveaus festschreibt, die nicht mehr den aktuellen Prioritäten entsprechen.

segments.src: ## What Got Punted
segments.tr: ## Was aufgeschoben wurde

segments.src: The stopgap deal notably does not resolve several of the thornier disputes that have stalled full-year appropriations work:
segments.tr: Der Übergangskompromiss löst insbesondere mehrere der heiklen Streitpunkte nicht, die die Arbeit an den Ganzjahres-Ausgabengesetzen blockiert haben:

segments.src: - **Topline spending levels** — how much to allocate between defense and non-defense discretionary programs remains unsettled.
segments.tr: - **Gesamtausgabenniveau** — wie viel zwischen verteidigungsbezogenen und nicht-verteidigungsbezogenen ermessensabhängigen Programmen aufgeteilt werden soll, bleibt ungeklärt.

segments.src: - **Policy riders** — provisions attached to individual spending bills that touch on regulatory and agency-specific policy questions continue to be a sticking point between the chambers.
segments.tr: - **Politische Zusatzklauseln (Policy Riders)** — Bestimmungen, die an einzelne Ausgabengesetze angehängt sind und regulatorische sowie behördenspezifische Politikfragen betreffen, bleiben ein Streitpunkt zwischen den Kammern.

segments.src: - **Individual agency allocations** — several of the twelve annual appropriations bills have not advanced far enough to reconcile House and Senate versions.
segments.tr: - **Einzelne Behördenmittel** — mehrere der zwölf jährlichen Ausgabengesetze sind noch nicht weit genug fortgeschritten, um die Versionen von Repräsentantenhaus und Senat zu harmonisieren.

segments.src: In other words, the CR keeps the lights on without answering any of the questions that made passing full-year funding difficult in the first place.
segments.tr: Mit anderen Worten: Die CR hält den Betrieb aufrecht, ohne eine der Fragen zu beantworten, die das Verabschieden der Ganzjahresfinanzierung überhaupt erst so schwierig gemacht haben.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Backdrop
segments.tr: ## Der Hintergrund der Zwischenwahlen

segments.src: Timing matters here.
segments.tr: Das Timing spielt hier eine wichtige Rolle.

segments.src: A funding fight dragging into an election year raises the stakes for both parties, since a shutdown close to voting season tends to generate outsized political blame in whichever direction voters assign it.
segments.tr: Ein Haushaltsstreit, der sich in ein Wahljahr hineinzieht, erhöht das Risiko für beide Parteien, da ein Shutdown nahe an der Wahlperiode tendenziell übermäßige politische Schuldzuweisungen in die Richtung erzeugt, die die Wähler festlegen.

segments.src: By pushing the next deadline to December, lawmakers buy themselves a legislative session removed from the most intense phase of midterm campaigning, even as the underlying disputes — spending levels, riders, and individual agency budgets — will still need to be resolved eventually.
segments.tr: Indem die Abgeordneten die nächste Frist auf Dezember verschieben, verschaffen sie sich eine Sitzungsperiode abseits der intensivsten Phase des Zwischenwahlkampfs, auch wenn die zugrundeliegenden Konflikte — Ausgabenniveaus, Zusatzklauseln und einzelne Behördenbudgets — schließlich immer noch gelöst werden müssen.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Wie es weitergeht

segments.src: Federal agencies, contractors, and grant recipients now have a period of funding certainty, but it's a conditional one.
segments.tr: Bundesbehörden, Auftragnehmer und Empfänger von Fördergeldern haben nun eine Phase der Finanzierungssicherheit, aber diese ist an Bedingungen geknüpft.

segments.src: Budget offices across the government will continue operating under current-year funding levels rather than any newly negotiated amounts, and agencies generally avoid launching new initiatives during CR periods due to the funding uncertainty involved.
segments.tr: Haushaltsämter in der gesamten Regierung werden weiterhin unter den Finanzierungsebenen des laufenden Jahres operieren und nicht mit neu ausgehandelten Beträgen, und Behörden vermeiden es in der Regel, während CR-Phasen neue Initiativen zu starten, da die Finanzierung unsicher ist.

segments.src: For everyday observers, the practical takeaway is straightforward: no shutdown in October, but the same fight resumes in December, closer to the holidays and with the same unresolved questions about spending levels and policy riders still on the table.
segments.tr: Für alltägliche Beobachter ist das praktische Fazit einfach: Kein Shutdown im Oktober, aber derselbe Kampf wird im Dezember kurz vor den Feiertagen wieder aufgenommen, mit denselben ungelösten Fragen zu Ausgabenniveaus und politischen Zusatzklauseln, die immer noch auf dem Tisch liegen.

segments.src: Whether that translates into a smoother resolution or another down-to-the-wire scramble will depend on how much progress negotiators make on the individual appropriations bills in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Ob sich dies in eine reibungslosere Lösung oder in ein weiteres Last-Minute-Gerangel übersetzt, wird davon abhängen, wie viel Fortschritt die Verhandlungsführer bei den einzelnen Ausgabengesetzen in den kommenden Wochen erzielen.

vi.title: 90-6 và Một Hạn Chót Được Tránh: Bên Trong Thỏa Thuận Tạm Thời Của Quốc Hội Để Tránh Đóng Cửa Vào Tháng 10

segments.src: With federal funding under the FY2026 appropriations calendar set to expire on September 30, Congress has once again reached for its most familiar budget tool: the continuing resolution.
segments.tr: Khi ngân sách liên bang theo lịch phân bổ ngân sách FY2026 sẽ hết hạn vào ngày 30 tháng 9, Quốc hội một lần nữa đã tìm đến công cụ ngân sách quen thuộc nhất của mình: nghị quyết tiếp tục (CR).

segments.src: A bipartisan measure to keep federal agencies funded into December cleared the Senate by a lopsided 90-6 margin before moving to the House, averting an October 1 shutdown that both parties said they wanted to avoid heading into a politically sensitive stretch of the calendar.
segments.tr: Một biện pháp lưỡng đảng nhằm duy trì ngân sách cho các cơ quan liên bang đến tháng 12 đã thông qua Thượng viện với tỷ lệ áp đảo 90-6 trước khi chuyển sang Hạ viện, giúp tránh được vụ đóng cửa ngày 1 tháng 10 mà cả hai đảng đều nói rằng họ muốn tránh khi bước vào giai đoạn nhạy cảm về mặt chính trị của lịch làm việc.

segments.src: The vote tally itself tells a story.
segments.tr: Bản thân kết quả kiểm phiếu đã nói lên một câu chuyện.

segments.src: A 90-6 outcome in a chamber known for narrow, party-line splits signals that neither side wanted its fingerprints on a shutdown this time around.
segments.tr: Kết quả 90-6 tại một viện vốn nổi tiếng với sự chia rẽ sát sao theo đường lối phe phái cho thấy không bên nào muốn dính dáng đến một vụ đóng cửa chính phủ vào lúc này.

segments.src: But the lopsided count also masks how little the underlying disagreements have actually been resolved — a continuing resolution, by design, doesn't settle a budget fight so much as postpone it.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, kết quả chênh lệch này cũng che đậy thực tế rằng những bất đồng cốt lõi chưa hề được giải quyết — một nghị quyết tiếp tục, theo đúng bản chất của nó, không phải là giải quyết một cuộc chiến ngân sách mà chỉ là trì hoãn nó.

segments.src: ## What a Continuing Resolution Actually Does
segments.tr: ## Bản Chất Của Một Nghị Quyết Tiếp Tục (CR)

segments.src: A CR is a stopgap spending bill that extends current funding levels for federal agencies past the start of a new fiscal year, buying lawmakers more time to negotiate full-year appropriations bills.
segments.tr: CR là một dự luật chi tiêu tạm thời gia hạn mức ngân sách hiện tại cho các cơ quan liên bang qua thời điểm bắt đầu năm tài chính mới, giúp các nhà lập pháp có thêm thời gian để đàm phán các dự luật phân bổ ngân sách cho cả năm.

segments.src: It doesn't set new spending priorities or resolve disputes over individual agency budgets; it simply freezes the status quo, typically with minor technical adjustments, for a set number of weeks or months.
segments.tr: Nó không thiết lập các ưu tiên chi tiêu mới hay giải quyết các tranh chấp về ngân sách của từng cơ quan riêng lẻ; nó chỉ đơn giản là đóng băng trạng thái hiện tại, thường đi kèm với những điều chỉnh kỹ thuật nhỏ, trong một số tuần hoặc tháng nhất định.

segments.src: This year's version extends funding into December, meaning the government avoids an immediate lapse but faces the same cliff again before the holidays — and, notably, just weeks before the 2026 midterm election season shifts into higher gear.
segments.tr: Phiên bản của năm nay gia hạn ngân sách đến tháng 12, có nghĩa là chính phủ tránh được nguy cơ gián đoạn ngay lập tức nhưng sẽ lại đối mặt với bờ vực tương tự trước kỳ nghỉ lễ — và đáng chú ý là chỉ vài tuần trước khi mùa bầu cử giữa kỳ 2026 bước vào giai đoạn quyết liệt hơn.

segments.src: ## Why December, Not Later
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Lại Là Tháng 12, Mà Không Phải Muộn Hơn

segments.src: The choice of a December deadline wasn't accidental.
segments.tr: Lựa chọn hạn chót vào tháng 12 không phải là ngẫu nhiên.

segments.src: It's long enough to avoid the optics of a shutdown heading into October, but short enough that leadership in both chambers retains leverage to force another round of negotiations before lawmakers leave for the holidays.
segments.tr: Thời hạn này đủ dài để tránh hình ảnh tiêu cực của một vụ đóng cửa trước khi bước vào tháng 10, nhưng đủ ngắn để lãnh đạo cả hai viện duy trì thế chủ động nhằm ép buộc một vòng đàm phán khác trước khi các nhà lập pháp nghỉ lễ.

segments.src: Punting past the midterms entirely would have required a much longer CR — an option that reportedly drew resistance from lawmakers who worry that funding agencies on autopilot for a full year erodes Congress's power of the purse and locks in spending levels that no longer reflect current priorities.
segments.tr: Trì hoãn qua hẳn kỳ bầu cử giữa kỳ sẽ đòi hỏi một CR kéo dài hơn nhiều — một lựa chọn được cho là đã gặp phải sự phản đối từ các nhà lập pháp lo ngại rằng việc cấp ngân sách tự động cho các cơ quan trong cả năm sẽ làm xói mòn quyền nắm giữ ngân sách của Quốc hội và cố định các mức chi tiêu không còn phản ánh các ưu tiên hiện tại.

segments.src: ## What Got Punted
segments.tr: ## Những Giữ Bị Hoãn Lại

segments.src: The stopgap deal notably does not resolve several of the thornier disputes that have stalled full-year appropriations work:
segments.tr: Thỏa thuận tạm thời này đáng chú ý là không giải quyết được một số tranh chấp hóc hại nhất đã làm đình trệ công việc phân bổ ngân sách cả năm:

segments.src: - **Topline spending levels** — how much to allocate between defense and non-defense discretionary programs remains unsettled.
segments.tr: - **Mức chi tiêu trần** — phân bổ bao nhiêu giữa các chương trình không bắt buộc dành cho quốc phòng và phi quốc phòng vẫn chưa được quyết định.

segments.src: - **Policy riders** — provisions attached to individual spending bills that touch on regulatory and agency-specific policy questions continue to be a sticking point between the chambers.
segments.tr: - **Các điều khoản chính sách đi kèm (Policy riders)** — các điều khoản đính kèm vào các dự luật chi tiêu riêng lẻ động chạm đến các vấn đề quy định và chính sách cụ thể của cơ quan tiếp tục là điểm nghẽn giữa hai viện.

segments.src: - **Individual agency allocations** — several of the twelve annual appropriations bills have not advanced far enough to reconcile House and Senate versions.
segments.tr: - **Phân bổ cho từng cơ quan riêng lẻ** — một số trong số 12 dự luật phân bổ ngân sách hàng năm vẫn chưa tiến triển đủ xa để hòa giải các phiên bản của Hạ viện và Thượng viện.

segments.src: In other words, the CR keeps the lights on without answering any of the questions that made passing full-year funding difficult in the first place.
segments.tr: Nói cách khác, CR giữ cho chính phủ tiếp tục hoạt động mà không trả lời được bất kỳ câu hỏi nào vốn đã làm cho việc thông qua ngân sách cả năm trở nên khó khăn ngay từ đầu.

segments.src: ## The Midterm Backdrop
segments.tr: ## Bối Cảnh Bầu Cử Giữa Kỳ

segments.src: Timing matters here.
segments.tr: Thời điểm ở đây rất quan trọng.

segments.src: A funding fight dragging into an election year raises the stakes for both parties, since a shutdown close to voting season tends to generate outsized political blame in whichever direction voters assign it.
segments.tr: Một cuộc chiến ngân sách kéo dài sang năm bầu cử sẽ làm tăng rủi ro cho cả hai đảng, vì một vụ đóng cửa gần mùa bỏ phiếu có xu hướng tạo ra sự chỉ trích chính trị rất lớn về phía bất kỳ bên nào mà cử tri đổ lỗi.

segments.src: By pushing the next deadline to December, lawmakers buy themselves a legislative session removed from the most intense phase of midterm campaigning, even as the underlying disputes — spending levels, riders, and individual agency budgets — will still need to be resolved eventually.
segments.tr: Bằng cách đẩy hạn chót tiếp theo sang tháng 12, các nhà lập pháp tự dành cho mình một kỳ họp không bị ảnh hưởng bởi giai đoạn căng thẳng nhất của chiến dịch bầu cử giữa kỳ, ngay cả khi những bất đồng cốt lõi — mức chi tiêu, các điều khoản đi kèm và ngân sách của từng cơ quan — vẫn sẽ cần phải được giải quyết rốt ráo.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Điều Gì Sẽ Xảy Ra Tiếp Theo

segments.src: Federal agencies, contractors, and grant recipients now have a period of funding certainty, but it's a conditional one.
segments.tr: Các cơ quan liên bang, các nhà thầu và các bên nhận tài trợ giờ đây có một khoảng thời gian đảm bảo về ngân sách, nhưng đó là sự đảm bảo có điều kiện.

segments.src: Budget offices across the government will continue operating under current-year funding levels rather than any newly negotiated amounts, and agencies generally avoid launching new initiatives during CR periods due to the funding uncertainty involved.
segments.tr: Các văn phòng ngân sách trên khắp chính phủ sẽ tiếp tục hoạt động theo mức ngân sách của năm hiện tại thay vì bất kỳ khoản tiền mới nào được đàm phán, và các cơ quan nhìn chung sẽ tránh khởi xướng các sáng kiến mới trong các giai đoạn CR do tính chất thiếu chắc chắn về ngân sách.

segments.src: For everyday observers, the practical takeaway is straightforward: no shutdown in October, but the same fight resumes in December, closer to the holidays and with the same unresolved questions about spending levels and policy riders still on the table.
segments.tr: Đối với những người quan sát thông thường, kết luận thực tế rất rõ ràng: không có vụ đóng cửa nào trong tháng 10, nhưng cuộc chiến tương tự sẽ lặp lại vào tháng 12, cận kề các kỳ nghỉ lễ và với những câu hỏi chưa giải quyết về mức chi tiêu cũng như các điều khoản chính sách đi kèm vẫn còn nằm trên bàn đàm phán.

segments.src: Whether that translates into a smoother resolution or another down-to-the-wire scramble will depend on how much progress negotiators make on the individual appropriations bills in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Liệu điều đó có dẫn đến một giải pháp êm đẹp hơn hay một cuộc chạy đua nước rút nghẹt thở khác sẽ phụ thuộc vào tiến độ mà các nhà đàm phán đạt được đối với các dự luật phân bổ ngân sách riêng lẻ trong những tuần tới.
